examples.question: Which customers have placed more than 12 orders? Return only their names.
examples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 12)
examples.reference: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 12

examples.question: What is the name of the most expensive product in the Books category?
examples.sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=oi.order_id WHERE p.category='Books' ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1
examples.reference: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Books' ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which customers have placed more than 9 orders? Return only their names.
examples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*)>9
examples.reference: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 9

examples.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent (sum of quantity * unit_price) on orders that were not cancelled? Return only their names.
examples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items op ON op.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status!='cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(op.quantity*op.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 5
examples.reference: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which product categories were bought by customers from London AND by customers from New York? Return the category name.
examples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.city IN ('London','New York')
examples.reference: SELECT DISTINCT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE c.city = 'London' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE c.city = 'New York'

examples.question: Which product category had the highest revenue (sum of quantity * unit_price) from shipped orders in 2023? Return only the category.
examples.sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2023%' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1
examples.reference: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.order_date LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1
